_description: Vulnerability allowlist for pnpm audit. Each entry documents a known vulnerability that has been reviewed and accepted with justification. Only high/critical advisories need to be listed — the CI gate ignores moderate and below.

allowlist.justification: Transitive dependency of @prisma/dev (Prisma CLI tooling). Not used in application code — hono's serveStatic middleware is not invoked. Fix requires Prisma to release an update.

React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass. Affects >=7.12.0 <8.3.0; no patched version exists. Not reachable: the frontend is a client-only Vite SPA using BrowserRouter, not RSC mode. Downgrading below 7.12.0 reintroduces four advisories patched only at >=7.18.0. Re-evaluate when react-router 8.3.0 is published.

_entrySchema.justification: Why this vulnerability is accepted (e.g., dev-only dependency, not reachable in production)
_entrySchema.reviewDate: ISO date when the vulnerability was last reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD)
_entrySchema.nextReviewDate: ISO date when the vulnerability should be re-evaluated (YYYY-MM-DD)
